name: Date range
description: A two-month (or multi-month) calendar to pick a start and end date range, inline or in a popover (DateRangePicker). Side-by-side or stacked month grids, range start and end filled, days in between highlighted in a continuous wash band.

classes.ayy-date-range: Root container: displays month grids side by side (or stacked on narrow viewports). Day size follows data-density.
classes.ayy-date-range__month: One month container with a header, weekday labels, and a 42-day grid.
classes.ayy-date-range__header: The month title and navigation arrow buttons.
classes.ayy-date-range__title: Month and year heading (e.g. "October 2026"), with aria-live="polite".
classes.ayy-date-range__nav: Previous / next month button with directional arrow icon, aria-label, and focus ring.
classes.ayy-date-range__weekdays: Row of short weekday names above the month grid, aria-hidden.
classes.ayy-date-range__grid: The 42-day button grid, role="group" labelled by the month title.
classes.ayy-date-range__day: Day button with data-date="2026-10-12" and full aria-label.
classes.ayy-date-range__day--range-start: The start of the picked range: primary filled, rounded inline-start.
classes.ayy-date-range__day--range-end: The end of the picked range: primary filled, rounded inline-end.
classes.ayy-date-range__day--in-range: Days between start and end: wash-hover background forming a continuous connected band.
classes.ayy-date-range-picker: Trigger button styled like an input field, opening a popover with the DateRange.
classes.ayy-date-range-picker__value: Text displaying the formatted date range (e.g. "Oct 12, 2026 – Oct 18, 2026"). Empty shows its data-placeholder.

default.looks: Two side-by-side month grids with month titles, weekday names, and round day buttons; days outside the month are muted.

hover.looks: Wash-hover background, full text colour. In-range days darken slightly.

focus.when: :focus-visible on a day button or nav arrow
focus.looks: 2px ring, 1px offset. The grid is one Tab stop: arrow keys move the focused day.

disabled.looks: Dimmed and crossed out with a not-allowed cursor; still focusable so arrows can traverse it. Forced colours: GrayText.

selected.looks: Start and end days are filled with primary colour; in-range days are highlighted with a continuous wash-hover band. Forced colours: Highlight and HighlightText.

error.none: A date range cannot hold an invalid date: days outside min/max are disabled. For form validation, apply aria-invalid to the DateRangePicker button and display a FieldError below it.

loading.none: No loading look. If available date ranges are fetched from a server, render a Skeleton with the shape of the date range until loaded.

today.looks: A 1px inset ring and semibold text. Forced colours: CanvasText outline.

outside.looks: A day from the preceding or following month: muted text.

empty.looks: No range selected: shows data-placeholder muted like an input's placeholder.

sizes.density: Day cells are the md control height (32px compact, 40 comfortable, 44 touch); nav buttons are the sm control height.
sizes.width: Side-by-side months fit two month grids (approx 36rem), wrapping to a stacked single-column layout on viewports narrower than 48rem.

js: dateRangeMonth({ month, range?, hoverDate?, pendingStart?, today?, min?, max?, weekStart? }) → 42 days to draw; dateRangeLabels(locale?) → { month, day, weekdays }; dateRangeKeyTarget(key, from, { weekStart?, rtl?, shift? }) → day a key moves to; connectDateRange(root, { value?, months?, min?, max?, weekStart?, locale?, onSelect? }) → { setValue, update, focus, destroy } draws and wires the months on plain markup; formatDateRange(start, end, locale?) → formatted range string; isInRange(date, start, end) → boolean; isSameDay(a, b) → boolean. Date helpers on ISO days: addDays, addMonths, startOfMonth, startOfWeek, todayIso, parseIsoDate, toIsoDate, formatDate, localeWeekStart. dateRangePreviousIcon, dateRangeNextIcon, dateRangePickerIcon (SVG markup).

element.description: Wraps an .ayy-date-range: draws the months into it (replacing any static month markup) and wires the navigation arrows, keyboard movement, hover range preview, and start/end range selection. In an <ayy-popover> whose trigger holds an .ayy-date-range-picker__value, it writes the formatted range there and closes the popover when a range is completed.

attributes.start: Start of the picked range, ISO ("2026-10-12"). Updated when a range is picked.
attributes.end: End of the picked range, ISO ("2026-10-18"). Updated when a range is picked.
attributes.months: Number of months shown side by side. Default 2.
attributes.week-start: First column, 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday. Default: the locale's.
attributes.locale: Language of the month and day names. Default: the browser's.
attributes.name: Form name prefix: hidden inputs (<name>-start, <name>-end) carry the range.

events.ayy-select: { value, start, end } when a range selection completes, value a [start, end] ISO pair.

props.value / defaultValue: [string, string] | null — the picked start and end ISO dates
props.months: number — number of months to display side-by-side. Default 2
props.min / max: string — earliest and latest pickable ISO days; outside days are disabled
props.weekStart: 0–6, 0 = Sunday. Default: the locale's first day of week
props.locale: string — month and day names language. Default: browser locale
props.previousLabel / nextLabel: string — accessible names for navigation arrows. Default "Previous month" / "Next month"

DateRangePicker.renders: <button class="ayy-input ayy-date-range-picker" aria-haspopup="dialog"> + <div class="ayy-popover" popover> with a DateRange

props.value / defaultValue: [string, string] | null — the picked start and end ISO dates
props.onValueChange: (range: [string, string]) => void — called when range selection completes; closes the popover
props.placeholder: string — shown when no range is selected. Default "Pick date range"
props.format: (range: [string, string]) => string — custom trigger text formatter
props.months: number — number of months to display. Default 2
props.min / max: string — earliest and latest pickable ISO days
props.name: string — form name: hidden inputs carry start and end dates

a11y: The grid is one Tab stop. Arrow keys move the focused day by one day (mirrored in RTL) or one week; Enter or Space picks the date.
Every day button is named in full by its aria-label (e.g. "Wednesday, 14 October 2026"); aria-pressed indicates selection, aria-current="date" marks today.
Days outside min/max are aria-disabled, not disabled, so keyboard navigation can move across them without trapping focus.
DateRangePicker trigger is named by its associated label; the selected range or placeholder is read as its description.

Range start and end use solid primary fill, while in-range days use a subtle wash-hover band. In Windows High Contrast mode, start/end use system Highlight and in-range days use a 1px Highlight border.
do: Use DateRange when selecting a contiguous span of dates, such as hotel stays, travel bookings, billing periods, or report filter dates.
Use DateRangePicker for form fields where screen real estate is limited, popping up the two-month view on demand.
Provide sensible min and max boundaries to prevent selection of impossible dates (e.g. past dates for reservations).
Display two months side by side by default so users can easily pick ranges spanning across month boundaries.
dont: Don't use DateRange to pick a single date — use Calendar or DatePicker instead.
Don't use DateRange for non-contiguous multi-date selections (e.g. picking every Tuesday) — use a multi-select day picker or list.
Don't hide or disable navigation buttons to lock months; use min and max props instead.
Don't rely on color alone to indicate the range: start and end days have distinct border-radii and aria-pressed attributes.
